$comment: Generated from openapi.yaml, version 1.0.0-draft.5, by scripts/build-api-reference.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
title: Request body of POST /v1/businesses/{businessId}/gap-lists
description: A "Why Not Me" gap list: the places on one source where tracked competitors appear and the user's own brand does not. It is computed in the extension against the brands tracked there.

source.description: Where the list was read from, as a label. An AI Overview shown on a results page belongs to "Google results". Store it as text and accept labels you do not know.

subject.description: The Google query, or the question the user asked on the AI site. It can be an empty string: always for "Pasted answer", and whenever no question could be read. Do not require it and do not use it as a unique key.

capturedAt.description: When the page or answer was read, on the user's clock, as UTC with milliseconds. It is not the time of the save and it is not unique: saving the same reading before and after "Scan sources" sends the same value with different rows.

rows.description: One row per gap, in the order shown to the user (highest priority first unless they re-sorted).

surfaceId.description: Where the gap is, as a code. answer_text and citations belong to the answers of ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and to pasted text. ai_overview is Google's own AI answer: the AI Overview on a results page, and the whole answer of Google AI Mode. The others are blocks of a Google results page. scanned_page is a cited or list-style page that was found to be a gap only when "Scan sources" read it; `surface` says where it was linked from. Values in this version: ai_overview, organic, local_pack, forum, video, ad, featured_snippet, top_stories, shopping, answer_text, citations, scanned_page. A later version may add values: accept a value that is not in this list.

surface.description: The same place as a label for people. Use surfaceId and position in code, not this text, except to tell where a "scanned_page" row was linked from.

position.description: 1-based position inside its own surface on the page the user had open: the organic position, the order of the citation, the order of the item in its block. For surfaceId "scanned_page" it is the position where the page was linked from. null exactly when pageType is "surface". It is not an absolute Google rank.

title.description: Title of the page or item. For pageType "surface" it is a sentence written by the extension. Can be empty for an ad without a readable headline.

url.description: URL of the page the row is about, with tracking parameters removed. null for pageType "surface", and for some local-pack and ad rows that have no link.

domain.description: Host of url, in lower case, without a leading "www.". null exactly when url is null.

competitors.description: Display names of the tracked competitors found here, from the extension's own list (a competitor without a name is listed by its first domain). They are not ids and may not match the competitors stored for the business. Store them as text.

evidence.description: One English sentence, written by the extension, that says why the row is a gap. Show it; do not parse it.

pageType.description: Kind of thing the row points at. surface: the wording of the surface itself (no page). competitor-site: a page on a tracked competitor's own domain. list: a list-style page such as "10 best…". forum, video: results of those blocks. third-party: any other page. Values in this version: competitor-site, list, forum, video, third-party, surface. A later version may add values: accept a value that is not in this list.

actionable.description: true when the row is a page on another site, and the business could ask to be included there: not a competitor's own site, not an ad, not a local-pack listing. Store it as sent; it cannot be derived from pageType.

scanned.description: true when "Scan sources" fetched and read the page. title, competitors, evidence, pageType and contacts then describe the fetched page.

contacts.description: Ways to contact the people who run the page, found on the scanned page. Empty unless scanned is true. These are names, URLs and e-mail addresses read from third-party pages: handle them as personal data.

kind.description: contact: a contact, about or team page, or an e-mail link. author: the author's page, or the line that names the author. submission: a "submit", "write for us", "get listed" or "advertise" link. Values in this version: contact, author, submission. A later version may add values: accept a value that is not in this list.

label.description: Text to show for the link.

url.description: An absolute http or https URL, or "mailto:" followed by an e-mail address. Show mailto values as e-mail links; never request them.
